g.text: Evidence-grouped compression for 3D MRI report generation
One MRI sequence · fixed visual-token budget
Separate evidence groups; bind complementary attributes through shared support

text.tspan: Shared support across all roles of slot

g.text: (c) Training with paired MRI and reports
Auxiliary heads read final Z; removed for inference
Gradients reach the projector; Llama parameters stay frozen
LoRA LR ↑ · projector LR held constant
Slots are evidence groups; the background slot emits no token.
